name: get_notifications

params.name: page
params.rules: default 1; page size fixed at 20 by the server

notes: Model only data.title and data.body from the nested data object; ignore data.data. read_at != null means read.

body.message: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

task_after_success: Map each item to a notification tile showing data.title and data.body, with an unread indicator when read_at is null. Tapping any unread tile marks it read via mark_notification_read, regardless of url; tapping a read tile does nothing. Load-more failure keeps the list and shows an inline retry row. 401 unauthenticated is handled globally by DioApiClient.
out_of_scope: No navigation from a tile, ever (url is ignored). mark-all-as-read is a separate spec. Do not name any controller method refresh() (GetxController already has it).

open_questions.question: What can data[].data.data contain?
open_questions.answer: Irrelevant. Model only the outer data object (title, body); ignore the nested data.data.

open_questions.question: What does tapping a notification do?
open_questions.answer: Tapping marks the notification read (mark_notification_read spec), whether or not url is set. No navigation, ever, from the tile.

open_questions.question: What if loading page 2 fails?
open_questions.answer: Keep the loaded list and show an inline retry row at the bottom.

open_questions.question: What does tapping an already-read tile do?
What happens when pull-to-refresh fails?
open_questions.answer: Keep the current list, show Get.snackbar('Could not refresh', message). Never switch to the loading state.

open_questions.question: Route path and entry point?
open_questions.answer: AppRoutes.notifications = '/notifications' behind AuthGuard. Do not link it from other screens.
